nodes.title: Workflow Notes
widgets_values:
Workflow Goal:

Provide a clean reference implementation for
Anima based text-to-image generation.

This workflow focuses on simplicity, reproducibility, and education rather than including every available feature. It reflects a tested baseline for producing high-quality digital painting style results. Treat it as a starting point and adapt the prompt and LoRA stack for your preferred artistic direction.

----------------------------------------------------

Version 1.0

Created as a simple reference workflow for users getting started with Anima.

Anima seems very sensitive to CFG, Sampler, Scheduler selections. Experiment with them and you may get some pleasantly surprising results. I used Kirazuri in my reference implementation.

Purpose

✓ Educational
✓ Minimal
✓ Easy to extend

Verified

✓ Text-to-Image

Verified Settings

✓ CFG : 4.0 to 7.0
✓ Sampler : Euler / ER-SDE
✓ Scheduler : Simple / Beta

These settings were used to validate this workflow and are recommended as the baseline configuration.

Verified Resolution :
✓ UHD (1088 x 1920)

(Observation: Results looked good in lower as well as higher resolutions) 

Hardware Tested:

✓ RTX 2080 (8 GB)
✓ 64 GB System RAM
✓ ComfyUI 0.27.0

Next
